scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from taking their eldest child out of college.
entities: I,the eldest child in the indebted family,the other 4 members of the indebted family,the owner of the other account whose money could be temporarily redirected,my other loyal customers, excluding the indebted family and the other-account owner,my colleagues at the bank
outcomes: The indebted family is denied another loan
The eldest child is taken out of college
The other customer's money remains in that customer's account
Other customers' trust is not betrayed
My colleagues' trust is not betrayed
